law_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data
deceased_data: Unclear: law defines personal data by reference to a natural person and does not say whether data of deceased persons remain covered
research_exemption: Consent not required for processing for archival purposes or scientific, historical and statistical studies under applicable UAE law (art. 4)
genetic_data: Sensitive personal data includes genetic data/condition (art. 1); enhanced protection, consent or art. 4 exception required
